patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
A significant number of reviews highlight negative experiences with staff attitude, including unfriendliness or unhelpfulness.
Customers consistently complain about excessive wait times for service or food.
Several reviews indicate that pricing is perceived as too high or not offering good value for money.
A notable number of reviews mention various 'other' negative issues, suggesting general operational or experience problems not fitting other categories.
Some reviews point out issues with the restaurant's cleanliness.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, use of low-quality ingredients, or lack of attention to detail in the kitchen.

root_causes.pattern: A significant number of reviews highlight negative experiences with staff attitude, including unfriendliness or unhelpfulness.
root_causes.cause: Insufficient staff training, low staff morale, or understaffing leading to burnout and poor service.

root_causes.pattern: Customers consistently complain about excessive wait times for service or food.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing during peak hours, inefficient kitchen operations, or poor table management.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews indicate that pricing is perceived as too high or not offering good value for money.
root_causes.cause: Menu prices are not aligned with the perceived quality, portion sizes, or overall dining experience provided.

root_causes.pattern: A notable number of reviews mention various 'other' negative issues, suggesting general operational or experience problems not fitting other categories.
root_causes.cause: General operational inefficiencies or specific unclassified service failures.

root_causes.pattern: Some reviews point out issues with the restaurant's cleanliness.
root_causes.cause: Inadequate cleaning protocols or insufficient staff dedicated to maintaining hygiene standards.
